description: Clarksons Research is the research and data arm of the shipbroker Clarksons, providing data, analysis, forecasts and valuations on shipping, trade, offshore energy and offshore renewables. Coverage: global merchant shipping and trade, the offshore oil and gas industry and the offshore renewables sector, plus tracking of decarbonisation and alternative fuel uptake across maritime fleets; the firm states it processes millions of data points a day with more than 170 experts and 15,000 platform users. Format and access: subscriptions to online platforms, namely the Shipping Intelligence Network (markets and trade), the World Fleet Register (vessels and fleets), the Offshore Intelligence Network, the Renewables Intelligence Network, and an API Portal, together with tailored research and valuation services. Licence: commercial subscription terms, not read. Caveats: the pages read describe the platforms only at a high level, so the fields, vessel counts and history available in each were not checked; prices are not published. Simulation uses: fleet composition, vessel specifications and trade volumes for maritime port capacity planning, freight network flow and supply chain disruption models, and offshore wind installation fleet studies. Related records: Norway's open AIS stream (data-kystverket-open-real-time-ais-norway) for observed vessel movements and the EMSA marine casualty platform (data-emsa-emcip-marine-casualty-information-platform).
